# CONTEXT-01 Test Fixtures

Catalog of synthetic fixtures for testing full-profile JSON ContextBundle construction, whole-prompt budgeting, and mandatory context derivation.

## Synthetic Data Guarantee
All fixtures in this directory contain strictly synthetic, artificial data. No real personal records, actual employment histories, live vacancies, or external credentials are used.

## Fixtures Catalog
- `synthetic_context_request.json`: Baseline valid JsonContextRequest fixture with synthetic German candidate profile, bound NormalizedPosting, and explicit budgeting parameters.
